ENTITIES="Attachment Memo MemoRelation InstanceSetting User UserSetting IdentityProvider Inbox Reaction MemoShare UserIdentity"

is_data_layer() {
  case "$1" in store/*|proto/gen/store/*|proto/store/*) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
}

count_pattern() {
  local label="$1"; shift
  local OUTDIR="/tmp/count_$label"
  rm -rf "$OUTDIR" && mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
  while IFS= read -r file; do
    rel="${file#$REPO/}"
    is_data_layer "$rel" && continue
    dir=$(dirname "$rel")
    content=$(cat "$file")
    for entity in $ENTITIES; do
      matched=0
      for pat in "$@"; do
        eval "if echo \"\$content\" | grep -qE '$pat'; then matched=1; fi"
      done
      # entity-specific storepb
      case "$entity" in
        InstanceSetting) echo "$content" | grep -qE 'storepb\.InstanceSetting' && matched=1 ;;
        UserSetting) echo "$content" | grep -qE 'storepb\.UserSetting' && matched=1 ;;
        IdentityProvider) echo "$content" | grep -qE 'storepb\.IdentityProvider' && matched=1 ;;
        Memo) echo "$content" | grep -qE 'storepb\.MemoPayload' && matched=1 ;;
        Attachment) echo "$content" | grep -qE 'storepb\.Attachment' && matched=1 ;;
        Inbox) echo "$content" | grep -qE 'storepb\.Inbox' && matched=1 ;;
      esac
      [[ $matched -eq 1 ]] && echo "$dir" >> "$OUTDIR/$entity.pkgs"
    done
  done < <(find "$REPO" -name '*.go' -not -path '*/.git/*')
  
  echo "=== $label ==="
  for entity in $ENTITIES; do
    if [[ -f "$OUTDIR/$entity.pkgs" ]]; then
      c=$(sort -u "$OUTDIR/$entity.pkgs" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    else c=0; fi
    printf "%3d %s\n" "$c" "$entity"
  done | sort -rn
  echo
}
